title: The Painted Zones on a Ship Deck Nobody Is Allowed to Stand In

scenes.text: On every ship deck there are painted areas the crew will not stand in.
No machinery, no cargo. Just paint, and a warning.
To anyone visiting, they look like nothing at all.
The ropes holding a ship to the dock are under enormous tension.
Modern rope is synthetic, and synthetic rope stretches.
Stretching stores energy, exactly like drawing back a bow.
If the line parts, all of that energy releases at once.
The end whips back faster than any person could move out of the way.
The paint marks where it would travel. The safest place on deck is the one you never cross.
